title: A high-performance magnetically separable and reusable BiFeO3/Bi25FeO40 nano-photocatalyst for purifying water under visible light irradiation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36924-36937
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05709D, Paper
Open Access

Zahra Habibi Dehaghi, Maryam Ghiyasiyan-Arani, Mehdi Shabani-Nooshabadi, Forat H. Alsultany, Masoud Salavati-Niasari
As a saccharide-assisted sol–gel synthesized bismuth iron oxide nano-photocatalyst, the BiFeO3/Bi25FeO40 nanocomposite demonstrated excellent photocatalytic activity, stability and reusability.
